description: Source code implementing Vulkan-accelerated GRU (Gated Recurrent Unit) operations in PyTorch, including functions for forward pass, context packing/unpacking, and run-time execution within the Vulkan backend.

classes.name: GruPackedContext
classes.description: Class encapsulating packed context for Vulkan GRU, including serialization and deserialization methods.

methods.name: gru_input
methods.description: Performs a Vulkan-accelerated GRU forward pass with input tensors, initial hidden state, and parameters.

methods.name: pack_linear_op_contexts
methods.description: Packages linear layer weights and biases into Vulkan-specific contexts for each layer.

methods.name: create_gru_context
methods.description: Creates an intrusive pointer to a GruPackedContext object with specified parameters.

methods.name: run_gru_context
methods.description: Executes a Vulkan-accelerated GRU using a packed context, input tensor, and initial hidden state.
